tagline: Schedule design reviews from Figma milestones and create calendar events from project timelines
metaTitle: Google Calendar Figma Integration: Design Review Scheduling
metaDescription: Schedule design reviews from Figma milestones with the exact Figma frame attached to each event. GAIA adds handoff deadlines too. See the setup steps.
intro:
Figma is where design work happens: wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and design system components live in projects with their own version history and comment threads. Google Calendar is where design reviews, handoff meetings, and feedback sessions get scheduled. The gap between them means design milestones rarely appear on anyone's calendar, review meetings lack direct links to the files being reviewed, and the design timeline is invisible to stakeholders who rely on the calendar.

GAIA bridges Google Calendar and Figma so that design milestones become calendar events and calendar events become linked to the right files. When a project milestone or version tag is created, GAIA can schedule a design review meeting automatically with the relevant stakeholders and a direct link to the frame. When a design review is added to the calendar, GAIA can search for the relevant file and attach the link so reviewers have instant access.

This integration is built for product designers and design leads who want their design schedule surfaced in the broader organization's calendar, and for product managers who need design milestone visibility alongside engineering and marketing timelines.

useCases.title: Schedule design review meetings from Figma milestones
useCases.description: When a project version is tagged or a milestone comment is added, GAIA schedules a Google Calendar design review event with the right stakeholders, a direct Figma link, and an agenda pre-populated with the milestone details.

useCases.title: Attach file links to design review calendar events
useCases.description: When a design review or feedback session is added to the calendar, GAIA searches for the relevant project file and appends the direct link to the event description so reviewers can open the file before the meeting.

useCases.title: Design handoff events with Figma inspect links
useCases.description: When a design is marked ready for development handoff, GAIA creates a handoff meeting invite for the design and engineering team with a link directly to the inspect view.

useCases.title: Design deadline calendar events from project dates
useCases.description: GAIA reads project timeline information and creates all-day deadline events for each design deliverable, giving the broader team visibility into the design schedule in the tool they use for planning.

useCases.title: Comment review reminders on calendar
useCases.description: When a file accumulates unresolved comments older than a configurable threshold, GAIA creates a calendar task for the responsible designer to schedule a comment review session, keeping design feedback loops from stalling.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and Figma to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize Google Calendar via Google OAuth and your Figma account via its own OAuth in GAIA's integration settings. You select which teams and projects GAIA monitors for milestone events.

howItWorks.step: Configure milestone triggers and calendar event templates
howItWorks.description: Define which design events create calendar events, version tags, milestone comments, handoff status changes, and set the calendar event template including attendees, duration, and agenda format.

howItWorks.step: GAIA links design milestones to your calendar automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors for milestone activity and creates calendar events automatically. It also watches for new design review calendar events and attaches the relevant file links proactively.

faqs.question: Can GAIA link to a specific Figma frame or page rather than the whole file?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can generate direct links to specific frames, pages, or components when creating calendar events, allowing reviewers to open exactly the section under review rather than navigating the full file.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support the branching feature when syncing to Google Calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can detect branch merge events and create design review calendar events for the merged changes, supporting design teams that use branching for parallel workstreams.

faqs.question: Can GAIA notify collaborators when a design review calendar event is created?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can post a comment in the relevant file notifying collaborators that a review meeting has been scheduled and include the calendar event link, keeping the design file and the calendar connected bidirectionally.
